children: A solid rise in U.S. industrial production in September still leaves some lukewarm indicators. Production rises 0.7% in the month. Citi's Veronica Clark and Andrew Hollenhorst say in a note that "manufacturing production has moved mostly sideways since the spring and remains below production levels of 2014-18." They add that manufacturing production rose "a more modest" 0.3%. "While strong AI-demand has boosted business investment, much of this investment is imported, implying domestic production has not been as strong," Clark and Hollenhorst say. They add that higher interest rates and fading fiscal support represent headwinds to non-AI manufacturing into 2027. (paulo.trevisani@wsj.com; @ptrevisani)
